provenance.shapes: observed (Euclid Q1 MER catalogue, IRSA TAP; SExtractor moments)
provenance.injections: model_prediction (negative point mass, radial reduced shear)

assumptions.galaxy_selection: vis_det = 1 AND spurious_flag = 0 AND det_quality_flag = 0 AND point_like_prob < 0.1
assumptions.star_selection: vis_det = 1 AND spurious_flag = 0 AND det_quality_flag = 0 AND point_like_prob > 0.9
assumptions.threshold: 99th percentile of the field maximum under shape rotations
assumptions.pa_mapping: PA E of N = position_angle (25 MER VIS cutouts, 4 clusters)
